title: Define email service interface
description: Define the TypeScript interface for the email service. All email implementations (mock and Resend) must implement this interface.
acceptanceCriteria: EmailService interface is defined in src/lib/email/types.ts
Interface has send(payload: EmailPayload): Promise<EmailResult> method
EmailPayload type includes: to, subject, html, text, from, replyTo
EmailResult type includes: success, messageId, mode
Verify by importing the types in another file without errors

steps.details: Define and export: `EmailPayload { to: string; subject: string; html: string; text?: string; from?: string; replyTo?: string; }`, `EmailResult { success: boolean; messageId?: string; mode: 'mock' | 'live'; error?: string; }`, `interface EmailService { send(payload: EmailPayload): Promise<EmailResult>; }`
